name: Naren Arulrajah
title: Founder, OB Academy · CEO, Ekwa Marketing
bio: Naren is a visionary entrepreneur, CEO and Founder of Ekwa Marketing, a 200-person team that helps doctors in private practice dominate Google and digital marketing. He has personally consulted with ophthalmology practice owners across the US, helping them scale from startups to multi-million-dollar practices. A consultant, speaker, author and innovator, Naren founded the Ophthalmology Business Academy to give back to the ophthalmology community.

name: Guido Piquet
title: Chief Operations Officer, Mann Eye Institute
bio: Guido is the Chief Operations Officer for Mann Eye Institute in Houston and Austin, TX. Entering ophthalmology in 2006 as IT Director, he advanced to COO in 2016, and in his tenure the practice has more than doubled in size. His passion is finding new technology to make the business of ophthalmology run better, and developing the leaders around him.

name: Sarah Duval, COE, COA
title: Practice Administrator & Operations Expert
bio: Sarah is a Certified Ophthalmic Executive and Certified Ophthalmic Assistant with deep experience in practice operations, staff development, and the day-to-day systems that keep ophthalmology practices running efficiently.

name: David Lazar, MD
title: Ophthalmologist & Practice Owner
bio: Dr. David Lazar is an ophthalmologist and practice owner who shares a physician-owner's perspective on building a modern, patient-centered, and financially healthy practice.

name: Omar R. Shakir, MD, MBA
title: Ophthalmologist, MD/MBA
bio: Dr. Omar Shakir combines clinical training with an MBA perspective, focusing on the intersection of medicine and business strategy in the modern ophthalmology practice.

name: Deep Parikh, MD
title: Ophthalmologist & Entrepreneur
bio: Dr. Deep Parikh brings an entrepreneurial mindset to eye care, exploring how physicians can rethink care delivery and practice growth in the modern era.
